name: Canarys Automations Ltd.
summary: Canarys Automations Ltd. is an Indian IT solutions provider specializing in digital transformation for businesses globally. The company focuses on digitalization, modernization, cloudification, automation, and intelligence, offering a comprehensive suite of technology solutions. Its primary services include software development, cloud services, and advanced DevOps solutions. Canarys also provides specialized automation and telemetry solutions for water resource management, encompassing flow monitoring, flood early warning systems, and irrigation SCADA systems. The company develops proprietary products for project management, software auditing, asset management, and intelligent deal qualification. Canarys leverages artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics across its offerings to enhance operations and improve customer experience. It serves diverse industry sectors such as Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI), Retail, Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, Manufacturing, and government bodies for water resource management. With headquarters in Bengaluru, India, Canarys maintains a global presence, serving markets in India, North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
